name: NVIDIA backstop of OpenAI Ohio campus lease (SB Energy)

terms.maturity: 20-year leases; NVIDIA obligations end at the earliest of the 20th anniversary of each lease commencement, OpenAI terminating the lease, OpenAI reaching a satisfactory credit rating, or other customary events
terms.terminationRights: NVIDIA options: assume the lease, relet, sell, terminate, or defer up to a year
terms.notes: NVIDIA residual value guaranties to SB Energy (lessor) for leases to an OpenAI affiliate covering ~4.25 GW of IT load at the PORTS campus, Pike County, Ohio; aggregate payment obligation cumulatively capped at $105 billion for the initial commitment (NVIDIA 8-K 2026-08-17, Item 1.01). Trigger: OpenAI insolvency causing a lease default, or OpenAI failing to pay; NVIDIA then pays the shortfall between the guaranteed minimum value of the lease and what a replacement lease or sale recovers. Guarantees become effective at each lease commencement, grow as each of nine construction phases completes (first expected in NVIDIA fiscal 2029 per the 10-Q; the 8-K says ready-for-service expected beginning in 2028), and are limited to defined portions of lease and power payments. OpenAI reimburses and indemnifies NVIDIA. NVIDIA holds an option on ~3.8 additional GW (8-K and 10-Q; the Ex 99.1 release says 3.75 IT-GW). Lease length settled by the filings: 20-year leases (Ex 99.1 and 10-Q); the earlier 10 years (Axios) report is contradicted and superseded. NVIDIA total guarantee exposure at 2026-07-26 was $108.5B ($105.0B SB Energy + $3.5B other AI-cloud land, power and shell guarantees; 10-Q Note 10). The $1.5B NVIDIA equity in SB Energy is recorded once, in nvidia-sb-energy-equity.
